repository: MeniBreak — parsimonious breakpoint panel for meningioma recurrence
purpose: Reproduce the MeniBreak report numbers from retained code, and let an external cohort apply the same breakpoint-panel method to its own SEG data.

provenance.historical_source_report: breakpoint_panel_word_tables_fixed.docx (dated 2026-08-04; title 'A parsimonious breakpoint panel for meningioma recurrence')
provenance.chatgpt_claim: REJECTED. No ChatGPT/OpenAI URL or identifier exists in any source file's metadata, properties, links, or bytes. The prior claim that the scripts lived only in a ChatGPT workspace was unsupported; the scripts and outputs were recovered from the drive and are shipped here.
provenance.verification: Every value below was read from the shipped CSV and matches MeniBreak.docx to the printed precision.

cohort.restricted_definition: primary tumour, gross-total resection, no prior/adjuvant/induced radiotherapy, non-angiomatous

modelling.window_selection: top-k chi-square windows chosen inside each TRAINING fold only
modelling.windows: 20 equal arm-relative bins per autosome arm; binary presence; min prevalence 20 tumours
modelling.restricted_cohort: broad out-of-fold scores transported to the restricted subset (no refitting)

analyses/02_discover_hotlist.py.produces: in-fold window discovery and consensus stability list

analyses/03_full_ladder.py.produces: the full model ladder (WHO -> enriched) in both cohorts

analyses/04_scna_plus_panel.py.produces: SCNA vs SCNA+panel discrimination and matched-sensitivity operating points

analyses/07_fixed_panel_internal_referen.produces: internal reference AUC for the FIXED panel, scored as an external cohort scores it
analyses/07_fixed_panel_internal_referen.status: NOT YET RUN - requires MENIBREAK_DATA_ROOT; see docs/WHICH_MODEL.md

external_use.input: a generic SEG (sample_id, chromosome, start, end, event) + outcomes

apply/validate_fixed_panel.py.question: Does the PUBLISHED panel discriminate recurrence in my cohort?
apply/validate_fixed_panel.py.windows: fixed, read from reference/menibreak_panel_v1.csv; nothing learned from your data

scoring.count: risk = number of panel windows containing a breakpoint; ZERO fitted parameters (frozen marker)
scoring.refit: fixed windows as features, coefficients refit under patient-grouped CV (validates the window set)

apply/validate_fixed_panel.py.IMPORTANT: This is a DIFFERENT model from the one that produced the reported 0.702/0.735/0.752 AUCs, which re-selected 8 windows inside every training fold. Do not compare a fixed-panel result against those figures. The internal reference for the fixed panel has not yet been computed; run analyses/07_fixed_panel_internal_reference.py. See docs/WHICH_MODEL.md.

apply/menibreak_panel.py.question: Does the discovery METHOD find prognostic windows in my cohort?
apply/menibreak_panel.py.windows: re-selected inside each training fold of your own data

panel_definition.rule: union over horizons of windows selected in >=40% of training folds at k=5
panel_definition.discrepancy: The reproducible rule admits 11 windows; the report published 9. It additionally admits bp_14q_b18 (0.40 at 7y) and bp_2q_b14 (0.44 at 5y), while the published table keeps bp_3p_b10 and bp_6q_b19 at the same 0.40. The published nine are therefore not recoverable from any single threshold; both sets are shipped and labelled via `in_published_table`.

external_use.tested_on: data/example (synthetic); both entry points verified end-to-end; discovery recovers the planted 1p window

covers: patient-grouped folds keep a patient's tumours together
every tumour is tested exactly once; splits deterministic under seed
the leakage detector catches a deliberately bad split (negative control)
the segment schema declares no outcome columns
arm tiling is gapless; centromere-spanning segments split; overlaps reported
breakpoint features stay out of the arm-level SCNA feature group
exactly five clinical covariates; grade is a comparator, never a predictor
external SEG/outcome inputs are validated (units, vocabularies, columns)
the resolution preflight classifies platforms correctly
tests.run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python -m pytest tests/ -q

reproduction_status.panel_ladder_and_windows: RETAINED CODE + OUTPUTS — regenerate with analyses/ on the institutional dataset (IRB-restricted, not shipped)
reproduction_status.external_validation: RETAINED — negative result; single external cohort

elevated_grade_rescue.description: Fraction of never-recurring elevated-grade tumours correctly called low risk

panel_size_sweep.description: Panel AUC as a function of k (windows selected per fold)

restricted_transport.description: Broad out-of-fold scores transported to the restricted subset

limitations: Internal validation only: not yet validated in an independent cohort of comparable copy-number resolution. One attempt on a methylation-derived cohort (GSE189521) degraded, but that is a resolution mismatch rather than a refutation (~11 breakpoints/sample vs ~97; window occupancy 3.7% vs 27.8%).
The restricted cohort has 22/37/43 events at 3/5/7y; its largest effects are its least precise.
Research use only. No claim of clinical utility or prospective validation.
